# speckit-checklist Skill

Use before moving from spec to plan, or during spec review.

## Rules

1. Read the feature `spec.md` and constitution.
2. Choose a theme: `requirements` by default, or `security`, `ux`, `deploy`, `review`.
3. Generate concrete checkbox items.
4. Leave all items unchecked.
5. Write to `.specify/specs/NNN-feature/checklists/<theme>.md`.
